issues.description: getCategoryLabel replaces explicit ID->label map with heuristics, silently regressing known labels.
issues.detail: The prior CATEGORY_LABELS table was an authoritative, total mapping. The new heuristic ladder (special-case dict, version regex, length<=3 acronym rule) yields 'Trustboundaries' instead of 'Trust Boundaries' and will mislabel four-letter acronyms like SAML/OIDC. Restore the table as primary source of truth and use heuristics only as fallback. Also restores the deleted CategoryId union contract.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER duplicates ordinal 4 across Info and Informational, breaking bijection invariant.
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 papers over a producer-side data-shape mismatch and breaks the implicit bijection from severity name to rank. Any inversion, distinct-count, or stable sort over these entries becomes ambiguous. Fix by canonicalizing severity at the boundary (Info -> Informational) rather than aliasing inside the constant.

issues.description: CategorySelector conflates empty string and 'all' as null sentinels, with a dead branch.
issues.detail: Select emits only 'all' or a real id, so the empty-string branch in handleValueChange is unreachable. Worse, the public contract is string | null but internally 'all' doubles as the null sentinel, colliding with a possible real id. Pick one explicit sentinel constant and delete the dead branch.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes maxValue inside the row map loop.
issues.detail: maxValue is a property of the dataset, not the row, but is recomputed per iteration. Hoist it (and the percentage-fallback expressions) above the map so the invariant is explicit and cost is linear. Signals the wrong data shape: caller could also pass pre-normalized percentages.

issues.description: category__in removed from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES while Category filter is added elsewhere.
issues.detail: The PR introduces a Category filter on findings but deletes its active-badge config. If badges are still rendered from this registry, users will filter by category and see no active badge. Either confirm badges are rendered through a different path or restore the entry.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart's item.percentage field is overloaded with two semantics.
issues.detail: The same field is used both as a width-ratio relative to max and as a value/total share percentage, with calculatedWidth and displayPercentage derived from it. The data contract is ambiguous. Split into two named fields (widthRatio, sharePercent) or document which semantics callers must satisfy.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on three P1 contract regressions: getCategoryLabel trades an explicit, total ID->label table for a heuristic ladder that silently mislabels known inputs like 'trustboundaries' and any new four-letter acronym; SEVERITY_ORDER breaks its bijection invariant by aliasing Info and Informational to rank 4 instead of canonicalizing at the boundary; and CategorySelector overloads 'all' and '' as null sentinels with a dead branch. Secondary issues cluster in HorizontalBarChart (loop-invariant maxValue, overloaded percentage field) and a likely-orphaned category__in badge config. None block merge, but the contract weakenings should be tightened first by restoring the data table, normalizing severities upstream, and picking a single explicit sentinel.
